ruleset.name: bentley-skeleton-domain
ruleset.description:
Domain entities and value objects (src/*/Domain).
Entities are a different shape from services: WIDE but SIMPLE. A User has twenty small accessors, and an AclEntry constructor takes nine arguments because nine columns identify an entry. Neither is complexity, and neither is a reason to split the class. Applying the service limits here would push people towards artificial sub-objects or a setter-bag, both of which are worse than a wide constructor.
So the count-based rules (TooManyMethods, ExcessivePublicCount, ExcessiveParameterList) do not apply. The complexity and length rules do, and they are the ones that matter: a branching entity method is business logic that belongs in an Application service.
